# SB-1022 Safety bulletin: stored hydraulic energy

Hazard description
Stored hydraulic energy within the Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) presents a risk of unexpected actuation of movable guards, rapid release of pressurized fluid, and potential for crush, impact, or injection injuries during maintenance and inspection. Residual pressure can remain in accumulators and piping after system shutdown and isolation. Failure to verify and control stored energy has resulted in near-miss events in comparable systems; mitigation requires deliberate isolation, bleed, and lockout procedures before hands-on work.

Affected equipment
This bulletin applies to Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) located on Plant P3, line P3-L3. All work on EQ-P3-L3-SB01 that requires access behind guards, inside panels, or interaction with hydraulic components must follow the controls below. Lubricant and maintenance supply references for EQ-P3-L3-SB01: CFW-LUB-709.

Required controls
- De-energize and isolate hydraulic supply at source prior to any entry or component removal. Verify isolation visually and by attempting normal actuation controls with power removed.
- Bleed down all hydraulic lines and store components through designated bleed points until pressure gauges read zero, and residual motion is visually confirmed absent.
- Apply documented lockout/tagout on electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic sources in accordance with SOP-P3-L3-02 and SOP-P3-L3-03. Use mechanical restraints on actuators where practicable.
- Require two-person verification for energy isolation and bleeding steps; the verifier must sign the work permit or tag as required by local procedures.
- Use personal protective equipment appropriate to the task and hazards present. Prohibit single-worker entry for maintenance tasks where residual hydraulic energy could result in entrapment.
- Report any deviations or equipment anomalies to maintenance supervision and initiate corrective action per MM-P3-L3-SB01-S2.

Effective date
Effective upon release. All affected personnel must be briefed on this bulletin and the controls above before performing work on EQ-P3-L3-SB01.
